name: codex-usage-monitor
description: Monitor your Codex (ChatGPT) usage limits in the status bar with smart throttle and pacing recommendations

codexUsage.authPath.description: Optional path to the Codex app credential file (the JSON holding your ChatGPT access token and account id). Leave empty to use CODEX_HOME/auth.json when CODEX_HOME is set, otherwise ~/.codex/auth.json. Set this if your Codex app stores credentials elsewhere.

codexUsage.autoFetch.description: Automatically fetch usage data from the Codex usage endpoint on startup and at regular intervals

codexUsage.refreshInterval.description: How often (in minutes) to fetch usage data from the endpoint

codexUsage.showInStatusBar.description: Show Codex usage in the status bar

codexUsage.compactStatusBar.description: Use a compact status-bar label: '<icon> X% (current) Y% (week)' instead of '<icon> Codex Usage: X% (current) Y% (week)'.

codexUsage.thresholds.moderate.description: Usage percentage at which the Moderate urgency level is triggered

codexUsage.thresholds.high.description: Usage percentage at which the High urgency level is triggered

codexUsage.thresholds.critical.description: Usage percentage at which the Critical urgency level is triggered

codexUsage.notificationTimeoutSeconds.description: How long (in seconds) Codex Usage notifications stay on screen before auto-dismissing. Set this so notifications never stack while VS Code is in the background. Manual dismiss via the X button is always available.

codexUsage.colors.moderate.description: Status bar background color when usage is at the Moderate level. Use a hex color (e.g. #cca700) or 'none' to disable highlighting.

codexUsage.colors.high.description: Status bar background color when usage is at the High level. Use a hex color (e.g. #f0643c) or 'none' to disable highlighting.

codexUsage.colors.critical.description: Status bar background color when usage is at the Critical level. Use a hex color (e.g. #e05555) or 'none' to disable highlighting.

enumDescriptions: Automatically evaluate thresholds against whichever metric is currently highest
Evaluate thresholds against the Current Session usage
Evaluate thresholds against the Weekly usage
codexUsage.thresholdMetric.description: Which usage metric the urgency thresholds and notifications are evaluated against
